name: Possessed Daeodons (7-8)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-15: Cleansing the Flame

stealth.details: or Detect Magic to notice the heavy divine magic in the area

disable: DC 24 Occultism check or DC 24 Religion check to disrupt the magic animating the spirits, DC 28 Athletics check to hold down one of the daeodons, or Dispel Magic (4th-rank, counteract DC 28). 3 successes are required.
reset: The hazard resets within 24 hours if the cultists of Sezelrian still remain in the area.
routine: (three actions) The animated daeodons trample all creatures within the circle, dealing 2d10+11 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Fires of Sabotage
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area of the ritual circle

---

Effect The outline of the circle alights with fire dealing 6d6 fire damage to all creatures within it (DC 26 basic Reflex save save). The trap then rolls initiative.

text: Three daeodon corpses, animated and enraged by Sezelrian's divine intervention, trample anything within the ritual circle.
